title: Aliyun Qwen Large Model Major Update: Empowered by Qwen3.8-MAX, Pioneering a New Paradigm for True Office Assistants. Text:

content_html:
Today, the Tongyi Qianwen large model under Alibaba announced a major functional upgrade, officially launching core capabilities such as "Thinking Research," "Scheduled Tasks," and "Office Assistant," and fully supporting the latest flagship model Qwen3.8-MAX. This update marks a key step in the evolution of large models from "assistant conversation" to "self-execution," aiming to address practical pain points for professionals in complex decision-making and repetitive work.

It is reported that the upgraded "Thinking Research" mode has been deeply optimized based on the original "Deep Thinking" function. This mode enhances complex reasoning and information integration capabilities, capable of generating structured research reports to support decision-making. For example, in business scenarios, it can automatically integrate scattered materials and generate required meeting reports with one click.

The most notable feature is the launch of the "Office Assistant" function. Unlike traditional AI that only provides text suggestions, the Qwen Office Assistant has the ability to connect with external applications and operating systems. It can not only integrate notes, calendars, and emails but also independently operate computers and browsers to complete multi-step tasks and directly deliver usable Office documents.

To address common challenges of data summarization across multiple formats in enterprises, the Office Assistant can automatically clean data and output the final result, truly achieving "real work and real delivery." Additionally, this feature supports cross-device collaboration between mobile and PC ends, allowing users to initiate tasks on mobile devices and have them executed by more powerful PC ends.

content_html_zh:
今天，阿里巴巴旗下同易前文大机型宣布功能重大升级，正式上线“思维研究”、“计划任务”、“办公助手”等核心能力，全面支持最新旗舰机型Qwen3.8-MAX。 此次更新标志着大型模型从“辅助对话”向“自主执行”演进的关键一步，旨在解决专业人士在复杂决策和重复性工作中的实际痛点。

据悉，升级后的“思考研究”模式在原有“深度思考”功能的基础上进行了深度优化。 该模式增强了复杂推理和信息整合能力，能够生成结构化的研究报告来支持决策。 例如，在业务场景中，可以自动整合分散的资料，一键生成所需的会议报告。

最引人注目的就是“办公助手”功能的推出。 与传统AI仅提供文字建议不同，Qwen Office Assistant具有与外部应用程序和操作系统连接的能力。 它不仅可以集成笔记、日历和电子邮件，还可以独立操作计算机和浏览器来完成多步骤任务并直接交付可用的 Office 文档。

针对企业多格式数据汇总的常见难题，办公助手可以自动清洗数据并输出最终结果，真正实现“真工作、真交付”。 此外，该功能还支持移动端和PC端的跨设备协作，允许用户在移动设备上发起任务，并由更强大的PC端执行。
